subject.title: Plugin Hooks: Missing trace context for observability (messageId, runId in all hooks, parentSpanId)

question: What single additive Plugin SDK trace-correlation contract should OpenClaw expose across agent lifecycle, outbound message, and subagent hooks?
rationale: Current main contains partial runId/sessionKey/trace-carrier pieces, but choosing flat span aliases, outbound run/message fields, and requester/child run semantics is public plugin API design rather than a safe automated cleanup.

options.title: Design one additive contract
options.body: Define the supported fields once, reconcile the narrower open issues into that contract, and implement the agreed API with docs, API baseline updates, and focused tests.

options.title: Keep narrow issues separate
options.body: Use this issue as the umbrella while implementing only the typed agent_start and outbound-message slices through their own open issues.

options.title: Defer new core hook fields
options.body: Leave current diagnostics and hook context as the supported surface for now, accepting that observability plugins must continue using partial correlation and heuristics.

recommendation.title: Design one additive contract
recommendation.body: Define the supported fields once, reconcile the narrower open issues into that contract, and implement the agreed API with docs, API baseline updates, and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest merged history on the trace carrier and hook correlation surfaces that this API decision would build on.
